method.name: HOV-inspired local/global fusion and observed-point association
method.backboneDisclosure: Uses PE-Core-L and SigLIP 2 so400m via route_jev, different backbones from HOV; this is not a HOV reproduction.
method.global: One full-image feature per photo; per-photo softmax of cosine(local, global) over observation masks
method.association: Cross-photo edges gated by native-point overlap and fused cosine; descending overlap * cosine, at most one observation per photo per cluster
method.overlap: max of the two directed nearest-neighbor fractions within overlapNative; at most 1024 observed points per mask
method.anchor: Largest supported-pixel count; mask area and source order break ties; same anchor for single_view and spatial_semantic

variants.multiview: Mean of fused features in existing catalog group
variants.spatial_semantic: Mean of fused features in label-blind cluster containing anchor

crossViewAblation.spatial_semantic: Fused nearest among overlap-gated cross-photo observations; no cosine gate for this nearest-neighbor ablation

method.crossViewDenominator: Every observation with a cross-photo candidate, including catalog singletons; one directed match per source
method.referenceCaveat: Existing entity IDs and referenceClasses are evaluation proxies, not ground truth; precision means catalog agreement
method.scoreMeaning: Cosine similarity, not probability or calibrated confidence
limitations: Native scale and camera/depth errors are unverified
Changing robot poses may fail geometry gates
Clusters do not combine generated meshes or hazard envelopes
Candidate classes and queries are a closed text list

protocol.referenceStatus: proxy catalog labels; yellow safety posts use user-described light curtain identity; neither is independently verified ground truth
notes: Frozen before embeddings. References are evaluation-only.
No policy ground truth or measured accuracy claim.
Geometry reuse: this is incremental semantics, not full reconstruction.

2026-10-04: one oneshot run is one physical scene (one cell, N >= 2 photos); object ids differ per scene, so evaluation references are keyed by catalog kind (referenceClassesByKind) and resolved against each run's catalog. Kinds follow the 2026-10-02/03 id maps (yellow safety post -> light_curtain, folded guard board -> vguard, ...); 'light curtain' and 'control cabinet' map to their same-named classes. Classes, queries and thresholds are unchanged from the 2026-10-03 protocol.
protocol.pointSource: MapAnything pts3d under canonical polygons and non_ambiguous_mask; no mesh points
